subject: reasoning
question: Mr. Akai starts from Point A and drives 16 km towards the north. He then takes a left turn, drives 14 km, turns left and drives 19 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 30 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given: **Mr. Akai starts from Point A and drives 16 km towards the north. He then takes a left turn, drives 14 km, turns left and drives 19 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 30 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/563d4da83ddbd8fec1c7cb79df00ad50967dc30670e84f7e4ddbfa7f44a1ce37.png] 

Thus, he should drive 16 km to the west in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
